$comment: Tracked test files that no vitest project collects, on purpose or until a named fix (#1216 item 2, checked by scripts/check-test-collection.mjs). Every other *.test.* / *.spec.* file must be collected by a vitest project. Each entry needs a path (exact, or dir/** for a directory), a reason, and a ref: an issue (#123) or the repo file that runs the tests instead. An entry that no longer matches an uncollected file fails the check, so remove it when its files are collected or deleted.
